summary: At the first debug wish for neutral altar, JavaScript stops after 16 matching screens although C creates altar terrain, prints "A neutral altar.", and continues. C objnam.c readobjnam() falls through its object searches to wizterrainwish(); the JavaScript readobjnam fallback refuses an unresolved wish before that call. Port the complete wizterrainwish() function and its return-valued readobjnam()/makewish() path, including terrain state, display, and C source order.

source.branch: objnam.c readobjnam() lines 4975-4993 calls wizterrainwish() when wizard mode is active, WIZKIT startup is not wishing, and no object class was selected. In wizterrainwish() lines 3687-3704, the "neutral altar" suffix selects ALTAR, A_NEUTRAL, and Align2amask without an RNG draw, prints "A neutral altar.", then performs shared terrain fixups through lines 3872-3915 and returns &hands_obj. The whole wizterrainwish() lines 3554-3915 also handles traps, furniture, water, lava, ice, graves, trees, doors, walls, corridors, and floors.
callers: objnam.c readobjnam() wiztrap label lines 4975-4993; js/objnam_readobjnam.js lines 1729-1755 currently throws "a wish no lookup resolves" before the missing terrain call.
zap.c makewish() lines 6360-6422 treats &hands_obj as a successful non-object wish; js/zap.js makewish() lines 1995 onward currently assumes readobjnam() refuses this arm and must handle its result.
wizcmds.c wiz_wish() invokes makewish() from the debug command; js/wizcmds.js and js/cmd.js already route this entry.
dependencies: objnam.c readobjnam() preprocessing and object lookup must precede wizterrainwish() so names shared with objects retain C precedence.

Terrain mutators, trap creation, water/lava damage, vision, newsym, switch_terrain(), and shared rm flags are needed by the complete function; its return-valued callees must follow the source port rule.
set_wallprop_from_str() and dbterrainmesg() are same-file helpers called by whole-function branches and belong with objnam.c port.

evidence: Saved v2 evaluation challenges/evaluations/20260925162000-v2.json at c7912bb5 has altar-rite-history 16/50 matching screens and 16/50 cursors. The immutable C recording is challenges/cases/v2/altar-rite-history.session.json; its SHA-256 is in the queue entry.

.cache/loop-20260925-v2-altar-scan.json replays 16 screens at examined commit 65e8da74 and stops at segment 0 step 16 with "unsupported wish: a wish no lookup resolves" after the typed neutral altar. C prints "A neutral altar." at that boundary.
nethack-c/upstream/src/objnam.c:3554-3915 defines wizterrainwish() and source-ordered terrain fixups; :3687-3704 is the exact neutral altar arm, and :4975-4993 is readobjnam()'s guarded caller.

js/objnam_readobjnam.js:1729-1738 documents the missing wiztrap fallthrough and throws; js/zap.js:1995-2007 explicitly assumes &hands_obj is refused. Both production caller sites must be wired with the new source function.
